'''2018 EGP Kyle Krueger LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
